page.layout: One page of text. Above the text, two round portrait medallions with captions around them, left and right. Below the medallions, one column of running text in two paragraphs. No marginal notes. Running head at top centre, page number at top right, gathering signature at the foot right.

main_text.l: D.IVD. ZOROBABEL
IESVM. SACER IEHOSVA
ZOROBABEL, filius Salathiel, Iudæorum Dux fuit
anno à mũdo condito 3418. ante verò Christum natum 544.
Hic Regis Iechoniæ in directa (quam vocât) linea, nepos erat:
qui cum Iehofua, siue Iesu, Sacerdote summo, in Iudæam remi-
grauit, & cum multis Iudæorum millibus: templi Hierosolymi-
tani fundamenta iecit, permittente Cyro Persarum Rege, qui
Babyloniam ceperat, regnúmque & monarchiam ad Persas
transtulerat, Rege Baltazaro interempto, iuxta Prophetiam ac
prædictionem Danielis, imperante apud Romanos Seruio Tul-
lio Rege sexto: quanquam Orosius lib.2.cap.6. sentiat regnan-
te Tarquinio superbo, septimo atque vltimo Romanorum Re-
ge, captam fuisse à Cyro Babyloniam. At vero Baltazar imperi-
tabat Chaldæis tempore Seruij Tullij: sub quo Baltazare Da-
niel scripturam mysticam legit & interpretatus est: autore Eu-
tropio, lib.1. Cæterum quatenus attinet ad historiam sacram de
Salathiele & Iehofua, consulito lib.1. Esdræ cap.1. & sequenti-
bus. item Aggæum & Zachariã Prophetas, & Ecclesiasticum,
cap.49. ipsum denique Iosep. lib.Antiq.10.cap.1. ac Ioan. Cario.
cron.lib.2.
IEHOSVA, qui & Iosue, & Iesus dictus est, summum
gessit apud Iudæos sacerdotium, temporibus Zorobabelis su-
pradicti, cuius & in remigratione ex captiuitate Babylonica
comes fuit. Vide vt supra. Hic (vt Philo refert) historiam Iudith
& Hester conscripsit. Fuit alter eiusdem nominis Iosue (ne er-
res) Israëlitici populi post Moysen Dux, qui cum Caleb in ter-
ram à Deo promissam tandem peruenit.

page.notes: The medallion captions are printed text and are given above as lines. The inscription at the top of the left medallion is too small to read and is not transcribed. "Iosep." is read with some doubt, as the abbreviation is blurred. The line "Hh 5" at the foot is read as the signature. Two lines of show-through appear faintly below the first paragraph and are left out.
